I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

It sounds like you enjoy taking a bit of time for yourself in the morning to get ready and feel confident. Having a daily routine can be really beneficial for both physical and mental well-being. The process of carefully applying your makeup can be meditative and help you feel more prepared to take on the day. Do you find that taking your time with your makeup routine helps you feel more energized and focused, or is it more about the sense of accomplishment and feeling put-together?

What do you personally think about this — is it right or wrong, and why?
